sources.entry: poetry-core - Poetry's PEP 517 build backend, usable without Poetry itself.

summary.one_liner: poetry-core is a lightweight, PEP 517-compliant build backend extracted from Poetry, letting pip and other build frontends build Poetry-managed projects without installing Poetry itself.
summary.what_it_does: Provides the build backend module poetry.core.masonry.api, which PEP 517 frontends call to build source distributions and wheels from a project's pyproject.toml. The project is enabled by adding a [build-system] table that requires poetry-core and sets build-backend to poetry.core.masonry.api. Once configured, pip can install or wheel a Poetry-managed project from source with only poetry-core as a build dependency. The README says it was split out of Poetry 1.1.0 to make these builds faster, since Poetry's other dependencies are not needed just to build a distribution. The README's contributing section notes that development follows the main poetry repository workflow, using poetry install and pytest.
use_cases: build a Poetry project with pip without installing Poetry
configure pyproject.toml build-system for a Poetry package
speed up PEP 517 builds in tox with isolated builds
create wheel or sdist from a Poetry-managed project
how_to_run: Add to pyproject.toml: [build-system] requires = ["poetry-core"] and build-backend = "poetry.core.masonry.api"
notable: Usable as a build backend without installing Poetry or its dependencies
Enabled via a standard [build-system] entry in pyproject.toml
Extracted from Poetry 1.1.0 onward to speed up PEP 517 builds
Works with PEP 517 frontends such as pip and tox
caveats: The README is brief and points to external documentation for full details
Intended for building projects; project management features remain in the main Poetry tool
